changes.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6 episode 13 ('Brand New Day', episode 123): Enoch kills the hunter Isaiah, wears his skin and infiltrates the Chronicom Hunters undercover to 'bluff' his way to Fitz and Simmons, then turns on them. The wiki lists 'Chronicom Hunters (undercover; formerly)'. The undercover stage is missing. The 'left' title stays.

Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6 episode 12 (episode 122): the recreated Flint refuses to help Izel, and she possesses him and uses his powers to rebuild the Monoliths (possessed service). She then leaves his body, and he escapes the temple with Mack, Yo-Yo and Deke, so ADD left 'Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6'. Note: Mack, Yo-Yo and Davis, who were also possessed by Izel, have no Izel's Crew stage, so the owner may want these handled the same way.

What If...? S1 episode 9: before the Watcher recruits her, Carter is a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent leading the STRIKE team to retake the Lemurian Star with Natasha (her S.H.I.E.L.D. service starts after episode 1, when Fury finds her in 2011). The record starts S.H.I.E.L.D. only at S2, so the S1 S.H.I.E.L.D. service before the Guardians is missing. The S2 return stage stays.

owner_calls.question: What If...? S3 episode 8: after Carter's sacrifice, the Watcher invites Kahhori, Byrdie (A:by-byrdie) and Storm (A:by-storm), whom he gave Watcher powers, to join him in watching over the multiverse. Is that joining a group (a new 'The Watchers' stage at What If...? S3, ending their Guardians of the Multiverse stage)? Related: the Order of the Watchers put Uatu (A:by-the-watcher) on trial and tried to erase him, and the MCU wiki marks his Order of the Watchers membership as 'formerly'. Does he leave 'The Watchers' at S3?
options: Keep all four as they are (watching with Uatu is not a group; Uatu stays a Watcher)
Add ['The Watchers','What If...? S3'] to Kahhori, Byrdie and Storm
Also end Uatu's Order membership at What If...? S3
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia's summary of S3E8: 'the Watcher grants Carter's team the powers of a Watcher ... the Watcher invites Kahhori, Byrdie, and Storm to join him in watching over the multiverse.' The fan wiki lists no Watchers affiliation for the three.
